metadata.title: देसी मुर्ग़ा आदिवासी स्टाइल बनाएँ अपने घर पर | Spicy Desi Chicken Recipe | Mataka Chicken
metadata.description: If you are a chicken lover and love to try different styles of cooking, please watch this episode of The Tribal Kitchen. We have explained the adivasi way of cooking Deshi Chiken on slow fire. After watching this episode you can prepare this spicy and delicious chicken curry at home.
